Name: Maachah, Wife of Jehiel
Summary: Wife of Jehiel the father of Gibeon.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:29; 1 Chronicles 9:35: Wife of Jehiel the father of Gibeon.
LifeLesson: The mention of Maachah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
